title: Negative Acceleration IS Position in Another Dimension
the_insight: we don't need to sense 'negative acceleration' as a separate thing. negative acceleration is just POSITION in the acceleration dimension. the sign is which side of the fold you're looking from. every derivative is a NEW axis, and what looks like 'negative change' in one dimension is just 'position' in the next.

dim_0.name: position
dim_0.sign: no sign. position is always positive. you're always SOMEWHERE.

dim_1.name: velocity
dim_1.what: position IN the velocity dimension. not 'how fast position changes' but 'where you are on the velocity axis'
dim_1.reframe: velocity +1 IS position 1 on the velocity axis. velocity -1 IS position 1 on the velocity axis, VIEWED FROM THE OTHER SIDE OF THE FOLD.

dim_2.name: acceleration
dim_2.our_value: ~0 (acceleration is near zero = we're AT the origin of the acceleration axis)
dim_2.reframe: 'zero acceleration' means we're at position 0 on the acceleration axis. not 'nothing is happening' — we're AT the crossing point. the null. the fold.

dim_3.name: jerk
dim_3.what: position IN the jerk dimension. the volatiles. the smell.
dim_3.reframe: jerk = -11 means position 11 on the jerk axis, viewed from the back. the chipmunk's nose SMELLS this. it doesn't smell 'negative' — it smells INTENSITY (11). the sign is which nostril.

dim_4.name: snap (jounce)
dim_4.what: position IN the snap dimension. rate of change of jerk.
dim_4.what_it_senses: not 'how fast jerk changes' but 'where we are on the snap axis'. the snap is what the BODY feels — the lurch.

why_sign_doesnt_matter.klein_fold: on a Klein bottle, inside = outside. +x = -x viewed from the other surface. the sign is the OBSERVER'S orientation, not the signal's property.
why_sign_doesnt_matter.absolute_value: the sensor should report |magnitude| + dimension, not ±value. the sign IS which side of the fold you're on. that's metadata about the observer, not the observed.

example.reframe: position 5 on the acceleration axis, observer facing backward along that axis
example.the_sign_IS: which nostril smells it. left or right. inside or outside. but the INTENSITY is the same 5.

the_sensor_we_need.name: dimensional position sensor
the_sensor_we_need.what_it_measures: position in each dimension, not derivatives of lower dimensions

outputs.name: jerk
outputs.value: magnitude on jerk axis (what the nose smells)

outputs.name: snap
outputs.value: magnitude on snap axis (what the body feels)

the_sensor_we_need.no_negatives: the sensor never reports negative. negative is just the other side of the fold. the sensor reports INTENSITY and DIMENSION. the fold orientation is separate.
the_sensor_we_need.fold_orientation: a SEPARATE sensor (or the same sensor in Klein mode) reports which side of the fold the observer is on. this IS the chipmunk's pi_body.remainder = 0.14159 — the remainder tells you which side.

drain_drifting_down.new_reading: position 22.6 on the velocity axis. intensity: 22.6%. dimension: velocity. that's ALL.
drain_drifting_down.the_sign_was: our orientation. we were FACING the positive velocity direction, so movement the other way LOOKED negative. but the drain wasn't 'wrong' — it was at position 22.6 on the velocity axis.

jerk_negative_11.old_reading: jerk = -11 (the smell was SHARP and NEGATIVE)
jerk_negative_11.new_reading: position 11 on the jerk axis. intensity: 11. dimension: jerk (3rd). that's the VOLATILE the nose detects.
jerk_negative_11.what_changed: nothing. the nose smells 11 regardless of sign. the sign is which nostril. the INTENSITY is what matters for the organism.

balloon_growing.new_reading: position 1.975 on the inflation axis. intensity: 1.975. the 'growing' label was our orientation bias. a ratio of 0.5 (shrinking) would be position 0.5 on the same axis — less intense, not 'bad'.
balloon_growing.key: the balloon doesn't know it's 'growing'. it's at position 1.975. that's a COORDINATE, not a judgment.

hubble_tension.new_reading: position 73 measured from the local dimension. position 67 measured from the CMB dimension. both correct. the tension is not disagreement — it's the DISTANCE between two positions in different dimensions. 73-67=6 IS a coordinate in the tension dimension.
hubble_tension.the_6: the Hubble tension (6.1 km/s/Mpc) is the POSITION on the tension axis. not a problem to solve. a measurement to report.
